notes.title: This game has a goat?
notes.content: I just published the new character 'Baphogoat' which plays with hp and damage, and the rune meta progression, also some quality of life changes but there's still road to come, and probably some bugs (i just discovered that if you click new game multiple times the game crashes. Wow at least that was fixed, i guess?) the free demo is coming as well.

notes.title: Early Access
notes.content:
Hello, early access is live and here is what i need to do:
+ More characters
+ More weapons
+ More meta progression
+ Bosses
+ More Skills and gadgets
----------
I will be on the lookout for any bug reports and suggestions c: The game is at least 70% of what my full vision for crystal storm is, any feedback is appreciated, you can use Steam Discussion Forums/Discord/Twitter/Youtube videos for that.

-Lukifah
